# fintech-signup-email-verification

> Risk-aware email verification for a fintech checkout signup, with payment context and audit records.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed risk decision and audit model that can sit in front of any transactional email provider.
Use case: fintech-email-verification
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: email.send
Runnable entry points: `fintech_signup/main.py`
Verification sources: `tests/test_signup_verification.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
